{{Quote|Name's Zyman, but you can pick what you call me. "Zyman," or "you," or "alien scum." Don't worry, I'm used to it.|Zyman|<ref name="Derailing the Rocket Tram" />}}
'''Kapp Zyman''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] demolition expert who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Axial Park]], where he recruited an Imperial hero to help him destroy a rocket tram line being used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to move their troops across [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="Derailing the Rocket Tram" />
